book.title: The New Penguin Book of The Guardian Crosswords, volume 3

clue.text: He gets the low-down, being a member of the party, right?

parts.words: being a member of the party
parts.note: someone who belongs to a group is inside it
R is the standard abbreviation for right

explanation.surface: Someone asks whether a party member is the one getting all the gossip.
explanation.walkthrough: The question mark covers the reading of 'right?' as a tag question; it is simply the letter R tacked on.
explanation.definitionFit: A person on the inside of an organisation has access to private information, the low-down that outsiders lack.

clue.text: Pressing for tick

definitions.meaning: first meaning: urgent, demanding attention now
second meaning: a moment, as in 'just a tick'

explanation.walkthrough: Tick is British informal for a very short time.
explanation.definitionFit: The word is an adjective for something urgent and a noun for a very brief moment of time.

clue.text: A dotty way to use a brush!

definitions.text: A dotty way to use a brush!

parts.note: surface reading: a crazy way of handling a brush

parts.words: A dotty way to use a brush
parts.note: setter's reading: a painting technique applying many small dots

explanation.walkthrough: Dotty is British informal for slightly mad, but here it means made of dots.
explanation.definitionFit: Stippling is painting or engraving with small dots or dabs of the brush rather than strokes.

clue.text: The German taken round the American centre gets a towel

indicators.note: taken round means placed around, so the German article encloses the other piece

parts.note: der is a German form of the

indicators.note: centre picks out just the middle of the national word

parts.note: the two middle letters of the word

explanation.surface: A German man is shown round a US centre and is handed a towel.
explanation.definitionFit: A towel is something that dries you, so it can be called a drier.

clue.text: This rogue might be made trustworthy

indicators.note: might be made suggests the letters could be remade into something else

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: A hope that a scoundrel can be reformed into an honest person.
explanation.walkthrough: The rogue's letters really are remade into a virtuous word, so the surface tells the truth.
explanation.definitionFit: A righteous person is morally upright and just, and so can be relied on and trusted.

clue.text: Provided in days gone by for pitch illumination

definitions.text: Provided in days gone by for pitch illumination

parts.note: surface reading: floodlights put up long ago at a sports ground

parts.words: Provided in days gone by for pitch illumination
parts.note: setter's reading: an old iron basket in which pitch or oil was burned to give light

explanation.surface: A historical note about how sports grounds were lit before electricity.
explanation.walkthrough: Pitch suggests a football or cricket field; here it is the tarry substance that was burned as fuel.
explanation.definitionFit: A cresset was a metal fire basket on a pole, filled with burning pitch or oil to light streets and halls in earlier centuries.

clue.text: A letter written after church to arrange a game

indicators.note: written after places the letter behind the church abbreviation

parts.note: CH is the abbreviation for church
ess is the spelt-out name of the letter S

explanation.surface: A letter is sent after a church service to set up a match.
explanation.walkthrough: The letter is spelt out as its name rather than given as a single letter.
explanation.definitionFit: Chess is a board game for two players with kings, queens and pawns.

clue.text: Shift when fit

definitions.meaning: first meaning: a device or makeshift means to an end

explanation.walkthrough: Shift is the noun for a stratagem, as in 'make shift', not a verb for moving.
explanation.definitionFit: As a noun the word is a convenient means or contrivance; as an adjective it means suitable or advisable.

clue.text: Such craft will work

parts.note: shall and will both mark the future
op is short for opus, a work

explanation.surface: A confident remark that such skill is bound to succeed.
explanation.walkthrough: Craft reads as skill; it means a boat.
explanation.definitionFit: A shallop is a light open boat, so it is one kind of craft on the water.

clue.text: The sunburned man's touching line

parts.note: sunburned skin is tanned; tan as an adjective
a gent is a man

explanation.surface: A sunburnt man delivers a moving line of dialogue.
explanation.walkthrough: Touching suggests emotionally moving; in geometry it means meeting a curve at one point.
explanation.definitionFit: In geometry a tangent is a straight line that touches a curve at a single point without crossing it.

clue.text: Carol holds back gratuity, and that's annoying

indicators.note: to hold something is to keep it within, so the carol word wraps round the other piece

parts.note: to carol is to sing

indicators.note: back tells us the gratuity word is read in the opposite direction

parts.note: a gratuity is a tip

explanation.surface: A carol singer withholds a tip, which is irritating.
explanation.walkthrough: Carol looks like a woman's name, but it is the verb meaning to sing.
explanation.definitionFit: Spiting someone means deliberately vexing or hurting them, so the participle describes behaviour that annoys.

clue.text: To interpret is no longer simple

parts.note: ex means former, no longer so
plain means simple

explanation.surface: A remark that interpretation has stopped being straightforward.
explanation.definitionFit: To explain something is to make its meaning clear, which is what interpreting does.

clue.text: Sounds appropriate in a sea-going vessel

parts.note: taken as written

indicators.note: in places one piece within the other, inside the vessel

parts.note: SS stands for steamship
to pirate is to appropriate someone else's work

explanation.surface: Something seems suitable aboard an ocean ship.
explanation.walkthrough: Appropriate reads as an adjective meaning suitable; it is the verb meaning to steal.
explanation.definitionFit: In phonetics aspirates are speech sounds made with a breath, such as the h sound.

clue.text: Do some digging in a model vegetable garden

indicators.note: in says the letters sit inside the following words of the clue

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word and the start of the next

explanation.surface: Gardening work on a showcase allotment.
explanation.definitionFit: To delve is to dig, both literally with a spade and figuratively when researching.

clue.text: A Greek character at the Exchange

indicators.note: to exchange is to swap places, so the letters before it change positions

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: A Greek person is spotted at the stock exchange.
explanation.walkthrough: The Exchange looks like a place of trade; it is the instruction to rearrange the two short words.
explanation.definitionFit: Theta is the eighth letter of the Greek alphabet, and a letter is a character.

clue.text: These days a guy splits supporters

parts.note: AD, anno domini, is the present era
a guy is a he, a male
rents are tears or splits

explanation.surface: Nowadays one man divides the backers.
explanation.walkthrough: Splits looks like a verb; it is the plural noun for tears.
explanation.definitionFit: Adherents are followers who stick to a cause or leader, that is its supporters.

clue.text: Immediately put in an awkward situation

definitions.meaning: first meaning: there and then, without delay
second meaning: placed under pressure to respond

explanation.surface: Someone is instantly put into an embarrassing position.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom means both straight away and in a difficult position where one must answer or act.

clue.text: A person prepared to deal with disorder — the strike first

definitions.text: A person prepared to deal with disorder

parts.note: taken as written
a rap is a sharp blow
first is written 1st, with the 1 read as the letter I

explanation.surface: Someone ready to handle unrest when the strike comes first.
explanation.walkthrough: Disorder and strike suggest industrial unrest; disorder means a mental illness.
explanation.definitionFit: A therapist treats disorders of mind or body, so is someone equipped to deal with them.

clue.text: Quickly getting a job as the orderly

parts.note: a post is a job

indicators.note: orderly here means put into order, so the preceding letters are arranged afresh

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: Someone is quickly hired as a hospital orderly.
explanation.walkthrough: Orderly looks like the hospital attendant, a noun; it is read as an instruction to arrange.
explanation.definitionFit: Posthaste is an adverb meaning with great speed, from the old instruction on urgent letters.

clue.text: Walking quietly, a worker carries dope

indicators.note: in a down entry, what is carried sits on top, so the dope piece goes above the worker

parts.note: p, piano, is the musical mark for quietly
a dope is a fool, an ass
the worker ant is a crossword staple

explanation.surface: A labourer walks softly while carrying drugs.
explanation.walkthrough: Passant is a heraldic term for an animal shown walking with one forepaw raised.
explanation.definitionFit: In heraldry passant describes a beast depicted walking, so the word means walking.

clue.text: Failing no tests, this is to go ahead

indicators.note: failing means going wrong, so the letters that follow come out jumbled

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: If nothing fails inspection, permission is given to proceed.
explanation.walkthrough: Read 'go ahead' as 'go a head': the answer is a hat, which goes on a head.
explanation.definitionFit: A Stetson is a broad-brimmed cowboy hat, an item worn on one's head.

clue.text: Topping decoration!

parts.note: surface reading: an excellent ornament, or something sprinkled on a cake
setter's reading: an ornament worn on top of the head

explanation.walkthrough: Topping is old-fashioned British slang for splendid; here it means sitting on top.
explanation.definitionFit: A tiara is a jewelled ornamental band worn on the crown of the head.

clue.text: Fat dunderhead in really good position

indicators.note: in places the head letter within the phrase for good position

parts.note: A1 means first-rate, the 1 read as I
the head of dunder is its first letter
a pose is a position held

explanation.surface: An overweight fool finds himself well placed.
explanation.walkthrough: Dunderhead looks like an insult for the fat man; split it as dunder plus head to get one letter.
explanation.definitionFit: Adipose means fatty, as in adipose tissue, the body's fat stores.

clue.text: The craftsman trains a replacement

indicators.note: a replacement puts things in new places, so these letters are reset

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: A master craftsman teaches an apprentice to take over.
explanation.definitionFit: An artisan is a skilled manual worker who makes things by hand, a craftsman.

clue.text: Deride the forecaster about one point

indicators.note: about means around, so the forecaster wraps the point

parts.note: a seer foretells the future
N, north, is one point of the compass

explanation.surface: Mocking the weather forecaster on a particular matter.
explanation.walkthrough: Point means a compass point, not a topic.
explanation.definitionFit: To sneer is to show contempt with a scornful look or remark, a synonym of deriding.

clue.text: Mad artist mistaken for a writer

indicators.note: mistaken means wrongly taken, so the letters are put in the wrong order

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: A crazy painter is confused with an author.
explanation.definitionFit: A dramatist is a playwright, a person who writes plays for the stage.

clue.text: She wasn't well brought up

indicators.note: in a down entry brought up means read from the bottom upwards

parts.note: ailed means was ill

explanation.surface: A woman who was poorly raised, either sickly or badly behaved.
explanation.walkthrough: 'She' stands for any woman's name; DELIA is one.
explanation.definitionFit: Delia is a woman's given name, and a female name can be defined simply as she.

clue.text: Confused tot left with a key

definitions.note: addle as an archaic adjective, as in an addle egg

parts.note: to tot up is to add
L is the abbreviation for left
E is one of the musical keys

explanation.surface: A muddled toddler is left holding a key.
explanation.walkthrough: Tot looks like a small child; it is the verb to tot, to add up.
explanation.definitionFit: Addle, now mostly as addled, describes a muddled or confused mind.

clue.text: In back streets serving men get this magazine

indicators.note: back says the whole run of words that follows is read from end to start

parts.note: lanes are narrow streets
RA is the Royal Artillery, soldiers who serve

explanation.surface: Men working in back alleys pick up a particular periodical.
explanation.walkthrough: Magazine suggests a periodical; it means a store for arms and ammunition.
explanation.definitionFit: A magazine in the military sense is a store of weapons and ammunition, which is what an arsenal is.

clue.text: Just the place for 1 ac!

parts.note: surface reading: a cross-reference to the person who gets the low-down
setter's reading: one who is inside belongs within the walls of a building

explanation.walkthrough: The answer to 1 across is someone on the inside, and the natural place for such a person is inside a house.
explanation.definitionFit: The adverb means within a building, the location fitting someone described as being on the inside.

clue.text: Appearing in a suit specially designed for a hot country

indicators.note: something specially designed has been reshaped, so these letters are reworked

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: Someone wears a suit tailored for travel to a warm destination.
explanation.definitionFit: Tunisia is a North African nation on the Mediterranean with a famously warm climate.

clue.text: An article about batting will be found inside

parts.note: the is the definite article
re means concerning, about
a batsman at the crease in cricket is in

explanation.surface: A newspaper piece about cricket batting will be found within the paper.
explanation.walkthrough: In cricket the side batting is said to be in.
explanation.definitionFit: Therein is a formal adverb meaning in that place or thing, so it means inside.
